shipped_rows.title_o: The drunk utilitarian: Blood alcohol concentration predicts utilitarian responses in moral dilemmas
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: Despite the use of a substantially larger sample and higher doses of alcohol compared with the ones in prior studies, alcohol had no significant effect on moral judgments. The results pose a challenge to the idea that alcohol increases utilitarianism in moral judgments.
